input: I'm a landlord and I'm going to rent out my apartment. Can I put in the contract that the tenant pays the IPTU and also the extra condominium fee to paint the building's facade?

checks.description: Classifies painting the facade as an extraordinary expense

checks.value: express(ly)?|stated in the contract|specific clause|clear clause
checks.description: Explains that the IPTU can be passed on by an express clause
Distinguishes it from the tenant's ordinary expenses
